name: Hypatia of Alexandria
summary: Creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer with over 5 years of experience in digital and print design. Skilled in Adobe Creative Suite, branding, and user experience design. Passionate about creating visually engaging designs that communicate effectively and resonate with audiences.

description: Lead design projects for major clients, focusing on branding and marketing materials.
Collaborate with the marketing team to develop graphics for social media and online campaigns.
Mentor junior designers in design principles and software techniques.
Created visual concepts to communicate ideas that inspire or captivate consumers.
Developed layouts and production designs for various print and digital publications.
Worked closely with clients to understand their vision and deliver on their goals.
Assisted in the design and production of marketing collateral.
Participated in brainstorming sessions to develop innovative design ideas.
Maintained project timelines to ensure timely delivery of materials.

extra_info.title: Projects
items: Redesign of the Atlanta Public Library branding

Design for local art festivals and exhibitions
